description: This file contains utility functions for handling configuration data in the Mattermost server, including marshaling, desanitizing, fixing, merging configurations, and utility functions for configuration validation and data retrieval.

methods.name: marshalConfig
methods.description: Converts a configuration object into indented JSON bytes for persistence.

methods.name: desanitize
methods.description: Replaces fake settings in the target configuration with actual values from the actual configuration.

methods.name: fixConfig
methods.description: Patches invalid or missing data in the configuration, such as removing trailing slashes and fixing locale settings.

methods.name: fixInvalidLocales
methods.description: Checks and corrects locale-related settings in the configuration, ensuring they are valid and supported.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two configuration objects, with the second patch overwriting the first where applicable.

methods.name: IsDatabaseDSN
methods.description: Checks if a given DSN string is a PostgreSQL connection string.

methods.name: isJSONMap
methods.description: Determines if a byte slice is a JSON object map.

methods.name: GetValueByPath
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a nested object or map based on a provided path of keys.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Compares two configuration objects for equality by marshaling them to JSON.
